lines.en: label day264:
scene karincat1
On a bench, sits a girl...
And beside that girl, a cat.
Beside the cat, the grass.
And underneath the grass, things we can not fathom.
If I had to take a guess, I’d probably say dirt.
Dirt and worms.
Things this girl and her sister likely played with in their backyard before they grew up and it became less socially acceptable to do things of that nature.
Now, instead of burying her fingers in the earth, she buries them into the fabric of her cardigan.
And the younger one, the one who is not here, buries hers in something else.
: Alone today?
scene karincat2
: I...I have pepper spray!
scene karincat3
: Oh...It’s you.
: Sorry, Sensei. I was just lost in thought for a moment.
: And I don’t actually have pepper spray. You’re safe.
: You probably should. That seems like a vital item for all [teenage]girls to carry.
: And you’ve certainly got enough bag space for it.
: Bag...space?
scene karincat4
: Oh, yeah. These bags.
: They’re not really mine. I’m just going to be hanging some fliers to try and recruit new members for the soccer team.
: In the middle of winter? And all by yourself?
scene karincat5
: Kirin was supposed to come, but I’m pretty sure she’s still mad at me for telling her to watch her language last week.
: Still? I could have sworn she was going to apologize to you.
: Kirin? Apologizing? I figured you’d know her better than that by now.
: I doubt it. I’ve definitely gotten to know her a little better, but I still don’t understand the first thing about her.
scene karincat6
: Yeah...she’s kind of hard to gauge. You’ll get the hang of it eventually.
: Especially since she...did all of that stuff just to wind up in your class.
: If you’re talking about causing trouble or whatever it was she said she did, it was a lot more simple than that.
: She probably just asked for a transfer the normal way, right?
: Oh, wow. You didn’t even have to wait for her to slip up and say it on accident to figure that out.
scene karincat7
: When you grow up sharing a bedroom with someone, you kind of learn their habits and tendencies and stuff.
: Also, if she ever told you I talk in my sleep, she’s lying.
: I stopped doing that like six years ago and after I found out, I was so embarrassed I didn’t leave the room for like three days.
: I will be sure to write that next to your name in my diary.
scene karincat8
: You...you write about me in your diary?!
: What? No. Obviously, that was a joke.
scene karincat9
: Y...Yeah! I knew that!
: Obviously you’d never write about me in your diary. You’d save that for all of the girls you’re closer to and-
: Karin, I don’t have a diary at all.
scene karincat10
: Just pretend I’m not here. I’m clearly not ready for this.
: Ready for what? We’re just talking.
: That. I’m not ready to talk.
: But we’ve talked several times now. We even went to the cafe together once.
: You also made me cookies. And they were great, by the way.
scene karincat11
: You...ate them?
: That is...what I was supposed to do with them, wasn’t it?
: I kind of expected you to just throw them in the garbage since it was probably really creepy getting cookies from some girl you barely even know.
: Well, I’m glad I didn’t. You should make me more sometime.
scene karincat12
: I will go home right now and make you a bunch more!
: Just do it when you have time...
: I have plenty of time! My sister ditched me!
: Don’t say such depressing things with a smile that wide, please. It makes me uncomfortable.
: Am I smiling? I’m...I’m totally not smiling on purpose if I’m smiling. What even is a smile? Like...right?
scene karincat10
: You can go back to pretending I’m not here now.
: In fact, I would probably prefer things that way.
: You’re doing great. Just think of communicating with me like...a sport or something.
: Ugh...how does Kirin do it so easily?
: Do what? Talk to me?
scene karincat13
: Y-Yeah.
: Any time I see her talking to you, her eyes get all wide and she says all this stuff she’d never even come close to saying at home.
: She’s like, a total recluse there. She never even eats dinner with us and when she does, she barely says a word.
: But with you she’s all like, “Aaaaaaaaaaaah!”
: You know?
: I think there was a more eloquent way that could have been worded, but I get it for the most part.
scene karincat14
: It probably sounds silly but...I want to do that too...
ka "I want to see you at the park we normally visit and be able to...actually hold a conversation without my heart feeling like it’s going to rip its way out of my chest and run
off to join the circus."
: I don’t think there are many circus openings in Kumon-mi. Let alone ones that would accept disembodied organs.
scene karincat15
: Then I shall carry it there in the container that is my body and accept my new role in life as a trapeze artist.
scene karincat16
: But I’m kind of afraid of heights, so I’m hoping they start me off with an easier job.
: As long as it’s not anything like cleaning the elephant pens or...talking to clowns, I think I’ll do okay.
: I’ve heard that circuses don’t pay very well, but living on the road sounds nice and-
: Karin.
scene karincat17
: Oh my god. You hate me now, don’t you? I’m so sorry.
: I have literally no idea what I’m doing.
: Are we still at[school]?
: We are...
: In fact, how long have you been waiting for Kirin to show up? I’m already done with my office hours, so I figured you’d have been long gone by now.
: I don’t know. Two hours, maybe?
: You’ve been waiting for her for two hours?...
That is extremely sad.
But also...why wait out here?
It’s freezing and she’s only like fifty feet from the entrance to the[school].
scene karincat18
: Well...
: I was waiting for her at first, but...
: Then I thought I might...catch you leaving instead.
: And there’s been something kind of bothering me that...I wanted to ask you about.
: If that’s the case, you should have just come to my office. That would have been a lot easier than waiting for me out here.
: But what if in the window of time it took me to get to your office, you happened to walk down a different flight of stairs?
: Then, without knowing, we’d pass each other...fated to always be just several steps away and looking out for the other as we drift further apart than ever before.
: Okay, sure. But I wouldn’t really be looking for you, so...
scene karincat19
: Sensei...
: What do you think of my sister?
: What do I think of Kirin?
: I think that she’s obnoxiously difficult to figure out. And that a lot of that comes from her not fully understanding herself.
: I don’t mean as a person...
: I mean as a...g...girl...
: You get nervous when saying the word “girl” now, too?
scene karincat20
: I get nervous with every word when you’re around! I can’t help it!
: Is there a reason you’re asking me this all of a sudden?
: Of course there’s a reason...it’s just...
scene karincat21
: It’s just even harder to say than...all of the other stuff that I have a hard time saying...
The cat beneath us and beside the grass looks up at Karin.
They say that cats can be good devices for calming people down, but no matter how hard this one stares at her, her hands remain trembling.
It could just be from the cold, but that’s unlikely.
I know what she’s asking.
She’s probably been worried about it for a while given how closely she’s observed Kirin’s mannerisms around me-
But that “joke” her sister said the other day about fucking her teacher has likely been lingering in the back of her mind ever since.
And she won’t feel better until she knows that nothing like that is going on.
She’s a good sister.
I wish I had someone like that.
: I g...guess what I’m...a...asking is if...
: You see her as more than just...another student...
: Because...l...like...
scene karincat22
: I’m so sorry...It’s probably unbelievable how I’m even...s...suggesting such a thing...
: It’s just...a weird side of her I’ve never seen before and...and I want to understand and...
: I’m worried...that you...
: That I’m too old for her?
scene karincat23
: N-N-N-N-N-No! That’s not it at all!
: I don’t think you’re old! I think you’re a great age! The best age!
: I...I’m worried for a different reason!
: And what reason might that be, Karin?
: A reason I can’t possibly say out loud!
(She loves me.)
scene karincat24
: I just...can’t stop thinking about it and...
: And I know she’ll never say anything to me, so...
: I wanted to know if...anything was...happening with...you two.
: I’m so sorry, Sensei...I know it’s not true, but...I need to hear it with my own ears or...
: Or I won’t be able to stop thinking about things that make my heart beat even harder than it normally does around you.
: And I need my heart. It’s the most important organ in my body.
: And it has a huge career ahead of itself in the circus as a trapeze artist and-
: Karin, calm down.
: Kirin’s my little sister, Sensei. To protect her, I need to know what she’s getting into and...
: And I need to know...who she’s...
I sigh to myself and search for a small pile of snow to kick up.
Unfortunately, there’s none around today and I suddenly find myself kicking the air and looking either very confused or flat-out weird.
There’s no easy way to answer this.
I either tell her the truth about the relationship between Kirin and me, breaking her poor little heart while providing her much needed solace...
Or-
I lie about everything and hope she’s gullible enough to believe someone twice her age, yet ten times more lost than she’ll ever be.
Decisions, decisions.
: Sensei...are you...involved with Kirin?...
: That’s...the only way I can word it without wanting to pull my hands off and feed them to this little kitty.
: How would you even pull the second-
: You know what? Never mind.
: Karin-
menu:
I’m not interested in her
: I don’t see Kirin that way.
: She’s a cute girl and...she's nice, I guess?
: But there’s no way I’d ever be romantically interested in her.
I start saying the first things that come to mind.
Things that Karin would be sure to believe given her inherent understanding of the girl we’re talking about.
But I have no idea how much, if any of it, she’ll believe.
I don't even know if any of what I'm saying is true.
Kirin and I have already crossed a line together that...
Well-
A line that would probably make her sister cry.
And I don’t want to make Karin cry.
So I lie through my teeth and hope she eats up every single, dishonest word I have to say.
scene karincat25
: God...I am...SO...so happy to hear that.
Dishonesty reigns supreme.
I fall closer to happiness and further from pure morality all at once.
scene karincat26
: To be honest, I was...kind of worried that maybe it was already a little too late...but...
: But now I’m feeling...a lot better.
: And...and that also means that...
: That maybe there’s...hope for...
scene karincat27
: I’m...I’m gonna go, Sensei!
: I suddenly have this crazy urge to run and...and I want to make sure I have time to finish my homework and...
: And there are...fliers and...um...
: Uhh...
: Bye! And thank you!
: Thank you so much!
scene karincat28
Karin grabs everything near her (Including the cat) and presses it all against her chest as she runs away.
A soft meow can be heard fading from earshot.
: What exactly was she thanking me for?
scene black
Congratulations! You are a liar!
Let’s hope Karin never finds out you came in her sister’s mouth!
$ karinlied = True
$ day264 = True
$ karin_love += 1
Karin’s affection has increased to [karin_love]!
Maybe one day, you’ll get to cum in her mouth as well!
jump afterschoolevent
I’m already involved with her
: I’m going to be completely honest.
: All of those things you’re worried about-
: Chances are they’ve already happened.
scene karincat29
: Already?...
: What do you mean by already?
: I mean that Kirin and I might already be “involved.”
: But I don’t think it would be good for you two if you were to mention knowing that.
: I kind of didn’t want to tell you anything in the first place, but...you’re her sister. So you have the right to know.
: What...what do you mean by “already?”
: What...what did you do to her?
: “With” her. Not to her.
: That’s a completely different thing.
: It’s not like I’m taking advantage of her. If anything, she came onto me.
Well, I came onto her as well, but-
Yeah.
scene karincat30
: S...Sorry...this is just a bit of a shock to me...
: Hahah...hah...
: This...this is what I get for poking my nose in stuff that’s not my business, right?
scene karincat31
: Hahah...hahahaha!
: The...the best part is that...I never would have found out if she’d have just shown up today.
scene karincat32
: You’ll be good to her at least...right?...
: She can be mean at times, but she’s such a sweet girl...
: And she has so much love to give...
: I’m glad she...she finally found someone who...she wants to...
scene karincat33
: Already?...
: Really?...
: How is that fair?...
: I...haven’t even...
Karin trails off before she finishes her last thought, but it’s pretty clear which direction it was headed in.
Kirin got the jump on her and it broke her in the process.
Or saved her, depending on how you look at it.
And she can’t even feel properly betrayed since she never made an effort to do anything about her own feelings in the first place.
Honesty hurts sometimes.
In fact, honesty hurts most of the time.
And all of those people who tell you honesty is the best policy-
They’re going to really hurt someone one day.
But they’ll be too high up on the pedestals they craft of their comrades' bones to ever even notice.
I look down at Karin from atop my pedestal.
And can’t help but wonder how much longer it will take for her senseless crying to cease.
scene karincat34
: Hah...if it were any colder out here, I think my tears would freeze.
: Karin...
: If you’re worried about me telling anyone...don’t be.
: Unless you hurt her.
: If you break my little sister’s heart...I’ll...I’ll do something about it.
: I have no idea what, but...don’t mess with me...
scene karincat35
: G-Got it...Sensei?
: I’d be a little more intimidated if you had pepper spray.
: Looks like I’m stopping at the convenience store on the way back, then...
: Do you, um...
: Do you know if Kirin is coming home tonight?
: No clue. I haven’t seen her today.
: Then she probably wants you to go look for her...
: Nah. I’m sure she’s just with her friends or something.
: Heh...looks like you’ve still got a lot to learn...
scene black
Karin gathers her things and begins to walk away.
She doesn’t say goodbye, but that’s probably because she starts sobbing the second her eyes break contact with mine.
Her walk turns into a jog.
The jog into a run.
A flier falls out of her bag as she makes a sharp turn around the corner.
And I feel it will be slightly longer before the soccer team recruits any new members.
$ karinlied = False
$ day264 = True
$ karin_love += 1
Karin’s affection somehow increases to [karin_love]!
But she cries the whole way home.
She really liked you.
jump afterschoolevent
